finalMessages: ShardShop cluster, database and broker foundation are ready; no application release was changed.
ShardShop deployment verified: current images, seeded catalog, routing, reader traffic and order saga outcomes; workloads remain running.

after.nodes: 4 running with the kind restart policy on-failure:1
after.postgresql: 10 pods on the new CNPG digest; ledger-db, shard-a, shard-b and shard-c healthy

outcome: Passed. All 20 steps passed, and every Maven run reported no failure or error. The cleanup deleted the owned lab: no owned node, container or kubeconfig context remained. All eleven acceptance scenarios have commands and passing evidence (shardshop-testing/ARCHITECTURE.md#acceptance-scenarios).
limitations: The applications and the migration image run on Canonical OpenJDK 25.0.4.1 without the October 2026 Java fixes. Ubuntu 26.04 had no 25.0.5 package on 2026-10-31; the user renewed the local risk acceptance until 2026-11-30.

The retained foundation upgrade witness (kind-upgrade-before, -after, -replay) needs a lab from a pre-5.3 revision and is not part of this sequence. The optional physical asynchronous-loss drill stays outside qualification.
The older-backup recovery uses Testcontainers PostgreSQL restore targets outside kind, by design.
